title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hook enhancements (baselining + flaky filtering)
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: improve per-prompt regression CI hook to reduce noise from flaky prompts and provide better baselining for multi-model comparisons. This PR adds a baseline registry, a configurable flaky-prompt filter, and tighter integration with eval-harness metrics so the CI hook can produce per-prompt signal and cohort summaries used by quality gating. The CI hook now: (1) resolves baseline automatically from PR metadata or falls back to rolling-7d; (2) computes per-prompt delta with statistical significance (bootstrap) and reportable effect size; (3) applies a configurable flaky filter that excludes prompts flagged as unstable in the last N runs; (4) uploads a compact metrics artifact (JSON lines) and a human-readable markdown summary to the PR checks so reviewers can inspect regressions quickly. Why: Teams were seeing noisy CI failures due to unstable prompts and small regressions flagged across many prompts without useful prioritization. This change reduces noise and surfaces high-confidence regressions. Notes: the description below includes implementation details, caveats, and rollout plan. Implementation details: - New baseline schema: eval-harness/baselines/{name}.yaml (model, dataset, timestamp, sample-size, seed) - CI hook changes: eval-harness/ci/per_prompt_hook.py updated to add baseline resolution, flaky-db integration, and bootstrap significance test. - Metrics schema: eval-harness/metrics/per_prompt_v2.jsonl (flat JSON lines; used by checks upload). - Added a small helper (eval-harness/tools/flaky_registry.py) that maintains an LRU of prompt stability and exposes an HTTP endpoint for the CI runner to query. - Tests: new unit tests for bootstrap logic and flaky filtering, and e2e CI job that runs a small synthetic job to validate hook output. Rollout plan: ship behind feature flag eval.per_prompt_ci_v2; default off for all repos. Gradually enable on main for the redwood repo after 48 hours of monitoring, then enable for redwood-sdk-* repos. Checklist: - [x] baseline registry schema design (+ docs) - [x] CI hook implementation + unit tests - [x] e2e synthetic job for CI validation - [x] PR check artifact upload (metrics + markdown) - [x] feature flag gating and docs update. References: Related Linear tickets and previous PRs on per-prompt gating: ENG-1127, ENG-1189. Support incident SUP-4432 where a noisy CI run blocked a release and motivated this work.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add baseline registry schema and docs; 2) implement baseline resolution and bootstrap tests in per_prompt_hook.py; 3) add flaky_registry helper and CI job to validate outputs.
files_changed: eval-harness/ci/per_prompt_hook.py, eval-harness/baselines/rolling-7d.yaml (new), eval-harness/tools/flaky_registry.py, eval-harness/metrics/schema_v2.md, tests/unit/test_bootstrap.py, tests/integration/test_per_prompt_e2e.sh, docs/eval-harness/per-prompt-ci.md
review_comments: Arjun: 'Nice work — baseline registry makes sense. A couple of notes: (1) can we avoid the HTTP call in flaky_registry on the runner path to keep CI hermetic? maybe fetch a compact file artifact instead; (2) prefer that bootstrap uses a deterministic seed recorded in the metrics artifact so reruns are comparable.' Evelyn (author): 'Reply: swapped HTTP call to a compact GCS artifact fetch (see commit 2). Added deterministic seed recording (metrics.per_run.seed). Updated tests to assert determinism.' Sofia: 'Can we add a small paragraph in docs about recommended thresholds (effect-size, p-value) for teams to adopt? Without that teams will copy defaults blindly.' Evelyn: 'Added docs with recommended defaults and rationale; noted that thresholds are repo-configurable.' Ben: 'CI run failed initially due to flaky_registry startup ordering in the e2e job; suggest adding retry/backoff to the test harness.' Evelyn: 'Added backoff and fixed the e2e job; re-ran CI successfully.'

release_notes: Added per-prompt CI hook improvements: baseline registry support, flaky-prompt filtering, bootstrap significance testing, and artifacts for PR inspection. Feature gated behind eval.per_prompt_ci_v2.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag; ops should watch eval.per_prompt_ci_v2 toggle and follow rollout steps in docs. If noisy regressions appear, consult eval-harness/README and use the flaky registry to mark prompts as unstable.
